verdict.rationale: The official setup docs offer a Docker path (alongside Pip) for installing the Khoj server, and the docs say it can be self-hosted on consumer hardware or your own device. Nothing in the evidence shows separate maintained guides for each deployment target. One community report of a Docker build failure (a pyside6 dependency error) adds some doubt about how well the Docker path is maintained. Missing for 10: an explicit Docker Compose guide, a Kubernetes/Helm guide, a small-VPS guide, a Raspberry Pi guide, and independent confirmation that the Docker path works reliably.
